full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 arc the sons and the plaintiff No. 3 is the daughter of Hosen Banu, through whom the plaintiffs claim the partible land. Hosen Banu's father Nazir Sheikh was the owner of the partible lands appertaining to khatian No. 285 of Mouza Kafrul. Upon his death the property devolved upon his 4 sons Baser, Yasin, Meser and Ismail and 2 daughters Hosen Banu and Saiyad Banu. According to the plaintiffs, Baser and then Yasin died as bachelors. Thereafter died Saiyad Banu, leaving behind her husband and children defendant Nos. 2 to 7. Meser was also unmarried and he remained untraced for over 40 years. He was presumed to be dead. His share devolved upon his only surviving brother Ismail and only surviving sister Hosen Banu. Thus Hosen Banu inherited 5/18th share of the suit property and the plaintiffs as her heirs inherited the same. The defendant No.1 Ismail who was the predecessor of the present petitioners, was the only surviving son of Nazir Sheikh. He having refused to partition the suit property arnicably, the plaintiffs filed this suit.
